//: AppSail config for the Catalyst-MANAGED Python runtime path (no Docker).
//keys: command / env_variables / memory are the keys Catalyst reads from app-config.json before deploy.
//port: Catalyst injects the listen port via the X_ZOHO_CATALYST_LISTEN_PORT env var. The startup command binds uvicorn to it (default 9000 for local runs).
//command: Data is pre-built and committed (backend/data/processed/api/*.json), so the runtime just serves it — no heavy pipeline run at startup. Binds to the port Catalyst injects.

env_variables.//CRIME_CORS_ORIGINS: set to your Slate frontend URL in production, e.g. https://<app>.catalystserverless.com; '*' is fine for the demo.
env_variables.//CRIME_USE_DATASTORE: 1 makes the /api/fir/live/* endpoints query Catalyst Data Store via ZCQL; unset/0 falls back to the JSON payloads.
